features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: A fixing device with a suction cup for supporting and mounting articles to a surface is provided by the present invention. The fixing device comprises a housing, a suction cup assembly and an air outlet formed in the suction cup
